title: Notes: Tab and Shift+Tab move only the bullet you are on
summary: Tab and Shift+Tab in Notes now move only the selected bullets with their children; Shift+Tab places the outdented bullet after its former parent so following bullets stay put, and Tab on a first bullet no longer leaves the editor.
friction: Claude Code killed the dev agent's local full `npm test` for low memory after a merge, and the agent reported FAILED on finished code; the orchestrator had it push and use CI as the suite run instead of releasing the story. Several full Vitest suites at once on this machine risk the same kill.
lessons_learned: A dev agent that reads a 'today X happens' note in an issue's Scope as unavoidable should test the claim against main first: round 1 shipped Shift+Tab unchanged from main and cost a review round.
